subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 3 — product consolidations (review request)

question: Should an existing `systemAgent.rescue.enabled: false` configuration continue to disable remote rescue after this consolidation, or should the project intentionally revoke that explicit operator opt-out?
rationale: The patch deliberately removes a user-controlled security boundary, and source evidence cannot determine whether maintainers want the smaller config surface to outweigh preserving an existing explicit opt-out.

options.title: Preserve a canonical opt-out
options.body: Keep a small documented rescue-disable setting and migrate legacy `enabled: false` values so upgrades retain the operator’s existing security posture.

options.title: Approve removal explicitly
options.body: Accept always-on rescue for eligible YOLO owner DMs, document that existing opt-outs are revoked on upgrade, and require clear migration and release-facing evidence.

recommendation.title: Preserve a canonical opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep a small documented rescue-disable setting and migrate legacy `enabled: false` values so upgrades retain the operator’s existing security posture.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author directly owns the proposed configuration retirement and has framed this choice for maintainer review.
